'''Rondar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|man]], who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Rondar was the son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]] of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]] and the heir to the throne of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. After Daimar was [[Blockade of Daimar|blockaded]] by the Empire, Rondar chose to remain on Daimar with his father rather than attempt to flee the world.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
